# Application commands

Command catalog version 2 uses the same snake_case identity in model tools and backend calls. Dotted command names are rejected; update callers and generated catalogs together.

Model parameters are declared separately in shared.json under their public tool names. Session identity and read receipts belong to application commands. Internal commands are not automatically model tools.

Terminal slash commands such as /research read are user interfaces that invoke these commands. Monitor API method paths and immutable transaction labels are separate contracts.

[Public model tools](public-tools.md) | [中文工具索引](public-tools.zh-CN.md)

results.json declares JSON response DTOs, including read variants and unsuccessful Job dispatch replies. It generates CommandResults and command-specific transport return types. Response schemas are checked against actual API replies in tests; production does not validate responses.
